sources.title: NekoTrail readme
sources.locator: Install; Agents; At a glance; Keyboard shortcuts; Status; support and privacy footer
sources.finding: NekoTrail runs coding-agent CLIs on the users machine, with a worktree/branch per task, local chats, queue, GitHub/Linear intake and PR actions. The app is free, MIT and has no account or paid tier. macOS13+ is primary; Linux packages are experimental and explicitly not yet tested on real Linux machines.

sources.title: NekoTrail src-tauri/src/agent.rs
sources.locator: Agent trait lines353–418; Claude.build, Codex.build, Gemini.build; command(spec); ALL
sources.finding: The source builds actual claude, codex exec and gemini subprocesses for a turn, sets cwd/environment, parses their session/tool output and supports conversation IDs. This establishes coding harness integration, not merely provider-model selection.

sources.title: NekoTrail src-tauri/src/acp.rs
sources.locator: OPENCODE; CURSOR; COPILOT; MORE; impl Agent for AcpAgent::build
sources.finding: The ACP adapter declares executable and arguments for OpenCode, Cursor CLI, GitHub Copilot, Goose, Qwen, Kimi, Auggie, Grok Build, Kiro, Droid, Mistral Vibe, Cline and Kilo, and launches Command::new(self.bin). Cursor uses cursor-agent, Copilot --acp and Grok grok agent stdio. The source notes limited vendor-side live verification; no agent was executed during this research.

sources.title: NekoTrail src/agents.ts
sources.finding: The per-agent table names sixteen distinct coding CLIs and their own login/setup commands. The MCP-sharing subset has only Claude, Codex, Gemini and OpenCode and must not be mistaken for all adapter support.

sources.title: NekoTrail src-tauri/src/cli.rs
sources.finding: The product-owned nekotrail CLI can create workspaces from tasks, list/status them, add queued tasks with fallback/check/PR options and request a handoff. It talks to the app rather than replacing the coding-agent executables.

sources.title: NekoTrail src-tauri/Cargo.toml
sources.finding: The desktop implementation uses Tauri2/Rust, a portable PTY and local SQLite. Linux and macOS have distinct native dependencies; a Windows boilerplate comment does not establish a supported Windows release.

sources.title: NekoTrail src/main.tsx
sources.locator: ReactDOM.createRoot; App import; Tauri window/webview setup
sources.finding: The UI renders the actual React App inside the Tauri window/webview.

sources.title: NekoTrail PRIVACY.md
sources.locator: Opening paragraph; Every network connection NekoTrail makes; What stays on your machine
sources.finding: The policy explicitly states no analytics, crash reporting or usage pings. It separately lists update checks, GitHub images/avatars/git/gh, optional Linear and away-alert requests and agent CLIs contacting their own providers. Chats/diffs/settings stay in a local SQLite database. This is not a claim of no networking.

sources.title: NekoTrail package.json
sources.finding: The bounded frontend dependency inspection finds React/Tauri/xterm/markdown UI dependencies and no declared analytics/crash-reporting package. This is corroboration of the published privacy statement, not a complete dependency or runtime audit.

sources.title: NekoTrail src-tauri/src/lib.rs
sources.locator: run; tauri::Builder plugin registration around lines5477–5482
sources.finding: The inspected backend startup registers opener, dialog, notification, updater, process and deep-link plugins; no telemetry initialization was found in this bounded startup inspection. This does not prove every transitive dependency has been audited.

sources.title: NekoTrail src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
sources.finding: The application CSP restricts direct frontend connections to IPC, with GitHub image hosts, while the updater endpoint is the projects GitHub Releases latest.json. macOS minimumSystemVersion is13.0.

sources.title: NekoTrail LICENSE
sources.finding: The inspected NekoTrail application source is MIT-licensed.

sources.title: NekoTrail docs/screenshots/changes.png
sources.locator: Exact original pixels: Changes tab; internal/server/http.go hunk; IdleTimeout30s removed and75s added; line and GitHub review comments
sources.finding: The genuine application renderer displays changed Go code with added/removed lines, inline comments and a Send review control. The sample changes IdleTimeout from30 to75seconds and adds ALB-related comments. This is vendor sample data, not evidence of a real coding result.

sources.title: NekoTrail docs/ROADMAP.md
sources.finding: The roadmap lists a notarized Mac app, Linux testing/AppImage restoration, more ACP capabilities and performance/polish next. Cloud workspaces, teams, accounts and mobile apps are not planned. These are directions, not dated delivery promises.
